title: GET /status has no linked regression coverage for setup state transitions
reasoning: This public endpoint gates first-run registration UX by reporting whether any user exists. A regression that flips registration_open or changes the response shape would directly affect setup/login behavior, but the feature metadata includes no linked tests exercising the empty-database and existing-user cases.
recommendation: Add focused API tests for GET /auth/status with no users and after inserting a user, asserting status code and exact JSON fields.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature lists an empty tests array, so there is no included test evidence covering this route's intended behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create pytest client tests that call GET /auth/status on a fresh test database and after creating a User, expecting {"setup_complete": false, "registration_open": true} then {"setup_complete": true, "registration_open": false}.
minimumFixScope: Add tests for get_auth_status; no production code change is required for this finding.
